newsitem.title: USA: Sony names Lee production chief at TriStar.
newsitem.headline: Sony names Lee production chief at TriStar.

text.p: Sony Pictures Entertainment, the film studio wing of Sony Corp, on Monday said it has named Chris Lee as the president of production at filmmaking division TriStar Pictures.
Lee, formerly vice president, production, will report to Lucy Fisher and Gareth Wigan, vice chair and co-vice chair of Sony's Columbia TriStar Motion Picture Group.
In a statement, Fisher and Wigan called Lee "highly respected by the creative community" and said "his many years of experience at TriStar provide him with a thorough understanding of the studio."
